# `<atk-timeline-item>`

A single milestone item in an atk-timeline.

**Use it when:** Specifying an individual milestone with date, title, status, and description.

**Do not use it when:** Do not use outside of an `<atk-timeline>`.

## Example

```html
<atk-timeline-item date="Q1 2025" title="Phase I Safety" status="complete">
  Primary safety endpoints met.
</atk-timeline-item>
```

## Notes
